answer: Continuous physical-presence sampling. Each identity must periodically solve a challenge tied to a unique local sensor reading, such as a marble rolling on a marked terrace, submitted with a timestamped geotagged frame. Verification checks the marble's position against the expected vertex trajectory within tolerance. An operator can't fake thousands of simultaneous physical scenes from one location; each identity requires its own camera, surface, and object, costing hardware and space per ID.
